description.en-US: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first, open-source AI content discovery companion. Its Firefox sidebar connects to the OpenBiliClaw backend you run, collects only the supported browsing and interaction signals described in the privacy policy, and turns them into cross-source recommendations, an inspectable private profile, and feedback-driven tuning. Supported sources include Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, Zhihu, Reddit, Linux.do, Bangumi, V2EX, and Weibo. Weibo public discovery is anonymous; when you explicitly run init, the extension uses a same-origin read-only task tab to import favorites, follows, and mentions from your signed-in browser. Only a boolean login state, uid, and normalized events leave the tab; cookies and site writes never do. The extension does not send data to servers operated by the OpenBiliClaw developers.
description.zh-CN: OpenBiliClaw 是本地优先、开源的 AI 内容发现伙伴。Firefox 侧边栏连接由你自行运行的 OpenBiliClaw 后端，仅采集隐私政策中说明的受支持浏览与互动信号，并生成跨来源推荐、可查看的私有画像和可持续反馈调教的推荐结果。支持 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube、X、知乎、Reddit、Linux.do、Bangumi、V2EX 与微博。微博公开 discovery 可匿名完成；显式运行 init 时，插件在已登录浏览器的同源任务页只读导入收藏、关注和 mentions。离开任务页的只有布尔登录态、uid 和规范化事件，不上传 Cookie，也不执行站内写操作。插件不会把数据发送到 OpenBiliClaw 开发者运营的服务器。

summary.en-US: Local-first AI content discovery, private profiling, and sidebar recommendations

version.approval_notes: OpenBiliClaw is local-first and requires a user-run backend. It does not load remote code or send telemetry to servers operated by the project. The optional all-sites host permission is requested only when a user explicitly configures a non-local backend; public hosts require HTTPS and device authentication. The declared data categories cover supported-site browsing/activity signals, user-triggered search and source tasks, locally stored authentication status, and comments/chat/danmaku text only after the user successfully submits it. Linux.do (`https://linux.do/*`), V2EX (`https://*.v2ex.com/*`), and Weibo (`*://*.weibo.com/*`, `*://*.weibo.cn/*`) permissions are read-only. Linux.do tasks use same-origin GETs for public topics or, after `/session/current.json` confirms identity, the current user's bookmarks/likes/read history; only normalized fields and a boolean login heartbeat leave the site tab. V2EX tasks return bounded rendered fields for the user's topics, public replies, favorite topics, and favorite Nodes; only A2 existence becomes a login boolean. Weibo init tasks use `/api/config` and bounded same-origin GETs for favorites, follows, and mentions; only normalized fields, uid, and a boolean login heartbeat leave the tab. Cookie values, page HTML, CSRF/once, private messages, and browser history are never uploaded, and the extension performs no V2EX write actions, no Weibo write actions, and no Linux.do write actions. Data is sent only to the backend endpoint configured by the user. A reproducible source archive is attached; from its root run `cd extension`, `npm ci`, then `npm run build:firefox` using Node.js 22. The output submitted for review is `extension/dist-firefox`. See docs/firefox-amo-source-build.md and docs/privacy.md for the complete build and data-flow explanation.

release_notes.en-US: Adds a Reinitialize / Rebuild Profile control to the extension. The backend creates a recovery snapshot before rebuilding the profile, refreshes the recommendation pool, and can optionally reset higher cognition layers. This release also stays compatible with the backend's evidence-driven temporal recommendation lifecycle.
release_notes.zh-CN: 插件新增「重新初始化 / 重建画像」入口；后端会在重建前创建可恢复快照、刷新推荐池，并可选择重置高层认知。本版同时适配后端的证据驱动时效推荐生命周期。
